tf.s: Adolescence is the period between childhood and adulthood.
tf.why: Yes! It is the time of change from child to adult.

tf.s: Adolescents are from about thirteen to nineteen years old.
tf.why: Right! These are the teenage years.

tf.s: Acne means ugly red spots on the face or neck.
tf.why: Correct! Acne often appears in the teenage years.

tf.s: Boys usually start their growth spurt earlier than girls.
tf.why: Girls begin earlier, as young as 10; boys between 12 and 17.

tf.s: Peer pressure can lead teenagers into bad habits.
tf.why: Yes, friends can push teens to do the wrong things.

tf.s: Paragraph 2 of the text is about relationships with the family.
tf.why: Paragraph 2 is about physical changes; paragraph 4 is about family.
'Physical' means related to the body; 'mental' means related to the mind.

tf.s: When you skim a text, you should read every word.
tf.why: The Top Tip says: skim, don't read every word.

tf.s: Teenagers can become self-conscious because they think everyone is looking at them.
tf.why: Right! They feel others are judging them.
Good! Teenagers still need the security of their families.
